Language and locale code (e.g. French, `fr`):

Take the current
[`src/_locales/en/messages.json`](https://github.com/Kevinjohn/sift/blob/main/src/_locales/en/messages.json),
translate every `message` value without changing keys or placeholders, and attach the file here or
open a pull request adding it under `src/_locales/<code>/`.
